description: Description Using PBIVizEdit SPC Time-Weighted Chart (Standard) you can create: EWMA chart for detecting small shifts using exponential smoothing. CUSUM chart for cumulative deviation monitoring. Moving Average (MA) chart for smoothed trend analysis. Features available: Identify small shifts early using EWMA, CUSUM, and moving average methods. Built-in mean, standard deviation, and control limits (UCL/LCL). Flexible control limits with custom constraints and aggregation. Fully customizable axes, labels, legends, and markers. Highlight rule-based violations (trends, runs, above/below mean). Smooth trends using moving average and time-weighted methods.
